locations.name: Kaushambi Bus Terminal & Wave Cinema Road

borderDetails.explanation: Located barely 250 metres across the Delhi-UP border from Anand Vihar, this road sits entirely in Uttar Pradesh, switching legal responsibility from MCD/PWD to Ghaziabad Nagar Nigam and GDA.

fallen_tree.responsible_authority: Ghaziabad Nagar Nigam (GNN) — Horticulture Division (Zone II Vasundhara)

portal.name: GNN 311 Citizen App / Nagar Nigam Portal

fallen_tree.reason: Even though directly adjoining the Anand Vihar border, Kaushambi is within Uttar Pradesh territorial limits, placing tree clearance under Ghaziabad Nagar Nigam.

damaged_road.reason: The Kaushambi transit commercial corridor was built and retained by GDA rather than transferred to the municipal corporation.

overflowing_garbage.responsible_authority: Ghaziabad Nagar Nigam (GNN) — Health & Sanitation Department (Zone II)
overflowing_garbage.reason: Solid waste management and transfer compactor stations in Kaushambi are operated directly by GNN Zone II.

broken_traffic_signal.responsible_authority: Ghaziabad Traffic Police & GNN Electrical Cell
broken_traffic_signal.reason: Traffic lights at the Kaushambi terminal junction are managed jointly by the district traffic commissioner and Nagar Nigam electricians.

borderDetails.explanation: East of the Delhi state police toll barrier, jurisdiction shifts to Ghaziabad Nagar Nigam Zone IV Mohan Nagar.

fallen_tree.responsible_authority: Ghaziabad Nagar Nigam (GNN) — Horticulture Wing (Zone IV Mohan Nagar)
fallen_tree.reason: Avenue plantation along the Maharajpur corridor is serviced by GNN Zone IV horticulture teams.

damaged_road.responsible_authority: Ghaziabad Nagar Nigam (GNN) — Mohan Nagar Engineering Cell
damaged_road.reason: East of the state border toll pillar, roadway maintenance transitions to Ghaziabad Nagar Nigam Mohan Nagar zonal office.

overflowing_garbage.responsible_authority: Ghaziabad Nagar Nigam (GNN) — Health & Sanitation Wing
overflowing_garbage.reason: Secondary waste collection on the Surya Nagar and Maharajpur service lanes is routed to the GNN Mohan Nagar transfer depot.

broken_traffic_signal.responsible_authority: Ghaziabad Traffic Police Unit (Mohan Nagar Circle)
broken_traffic_signal.reason: Maharajpur junction traffic control lights fall under Ghaziabad Traffic Police Mohan Nagar circle.

fallen_tree.responsible_authority: Ghaziabad Nagar Nigam (GNN) — Horticulture Cell (Zone II)
fallen_tree.reason: Park and avenue green cover in Vasundhara Sector 10 is maintained by GNN Zone II horticulture staff.

damaged_road.responsible_authority: Ghaziabad Nagar Nigam (GNN) — Zone II Engineering Division
damaged_road.reason: Sector 10 internal streets are fully transferred municipal roads under GNN Zone II jurisdiction.

overflowing_garbage.responsible_authority: Ghaziabad Nagar Nigam (GNN) — Health Department (Zone II)
overflowing_garbage.reason: Door-to-door collection concessionaires in Vasundhara report directly to the GNN sanitary inspector for Zone II.

broken_traffic_signal.responsible_authority: GNN Electrical Division & Ghaziabad Traffic Police
broken_traffic_signal.reason: Atal Chowk traffic light synchronization is managed by GNN electrical cell in Vasundhara.

locations.name: Raj Nagar Extension Commercial Spine & Bypass

fallen_tree.reason: Median plantations along the Raj Nagar Extension bypass are maintained by GDA horticulturists.

damaged_road.reason: Because Raj Nagar Extension is a developing township scheme, the primary arterial bypass remains under GDA supervision.

overflowing_garbage.responsible_authority: Ghaziabad Nagar Nigam (GNN) — Sanitation Cell (Zone V Kavi Nagar)
overflowing_garbage.reason: Solid waste handling in Raj Nagar Extension was formally handed over to GNN Zone V in 2024.

broken_traffic_signal.responsible_authority: Ghaziabad Traffic Police & GDA Traffic Engineering
broken_traffic_signal.reason: Signals at the Meerut Road bypass cut are installed by GDA and controlled by Ghaziabad Traffic Police.
